context.purpose: Extract georeferenced raster windows and resize their grid with nearest-neighbour sampling while retaining explicit CRS, band units and nodata.
context.assumptions: North-up PixelIsArea single-band uncompressed UInt16/Int16/finite Float32 GeoTIFF; GDAL 3.13.3 isolated Python on POSIX.
context.constraints: 262144 source/output pixels, 4096 per axis, 8 MiB file; EPSG:4326 longitude/latitude degrees or 3857 metres; units m, K, 1. No reprojection/bilinear/masks/overviews/extra metadata.
context.inspection: Stdlib GeoTIFF parser compares every output pixel, geotransform, CRS, units and nodata to an independent centre-sampling oracle, then compares fresh GDAL reopening.
context.recovery: INVALID_RASTER_CONTENT: inspect declared metadata and supported subset; RASTER_PIXEL_LIMIT: reduce dimensions; INTERPRETER_NOT_FOUND: configure isolated GDAL 3.13.3 interpreter.

workflow.scope: Verified image artifact handoffs, pixel-window chains and source-byte reuse identity.

composition.scope: Finite output grid dimension studies resolve before raster extraction.

lifecycle.timeout: One total deadline; shared owned process-tree runner; native AS2 GiB/CPU60 s/FSIZE16 MiB caps.
lifecycle.cancellation: Shared process cancellation and final prepublication cancellation check.
lifecycle.logs: Captured source, effective plan, trusted native worker, per-stage input hashes/stdout/stderr/submissions.
lifecycle.verification: Independent classic TIFF/GeoKey/pixel reader plus integer centre-sampling oracle, literal fixtures and fresh isolated GDAL reopening.

losses: Strict subset rejects unknown tags/extra metadata instead of silently omitting data.
data.scope: Captured regular local file <=8 MiB; 262144 pixels.

losses: Nearest downsampling drops unsampled pixels; no averaging/conservation claim.
TIFF strip layout, byte order and descriptive CRS citations may change.
data.scope: Extent-preserving north-up grid and source-bound statistical summary.

inspection.scope: raster-summary.json CRS/units/nodata/affine corners/statistics and native logs.
inspection.limits: Use GIS software for georeferenced display; Studio image preview may lack GeoTIFF support.

authoring.reuse: Edit source/window/grid after checking units; captured source hash invalidates changed bytes.

workflow.scope: Verified GeoTIFF handoffs to further raster windows.

property-authoring.scope: Typed pixel window, output dimensions, CRS/units/nodata contract.

conversion.scope: GeoTIFF input/output only; reprojection and alternate formats deferred.

native-inspection.scope: Batch readback and published summary only; no interactive session.

live-editing.scope: No native synchronization or process-local handles.

native-save.scope: Raster publication only; no application session file.

cases.scope: Literal negative-y geotransform/nonzero origin and Int16 nodata crop.
Non-integer4x3 to3x2 centre sampling, last row/column and nodata.
Big-endian Float32 Kelvin values and longitude/latitude degrees grid resize.

completion.scope: Initial GDAL window route: typed metadata, independently verified raster sampling and isolated lifecycle.

notApplicable.conversion: GeoTIFF input/output only; reprojection and alternate formats deferred.
notApplicable.native-inspection: Batch readback and published summary only; no interactive session.
notApplicable.live-editing: No native synchronization or process-local handles.
notApplicable.native-save: Raster publication only; no application session file.
